notes.title: Announcing the Drift Vector Playtest & High Score Competition!
notes.notes:
I hope everyone's been having a great SHMUP-Fest!

It's still very early days for Drift Vector, but it's been super helpful getting feedback from the game so far but I thought it might be fun to add a little spice to the proceedings with a [b]HIGH SCORE Competition[/b] for the remainder of the SHMUP-Fest!

To enter, go to [url=https://app.playcocola.com/i/2fe7e113-cbcb-44fb-b554-ac4b0ba93fdd]this Playcocola link[/url], read the instructions & you should be able to record a playtest session. I'd suggest around 20 minutes will be enough & then there'll be a short survey at the end. Whoever gets the highest score during their recorded playtest session before midnight (GMT) on Monday will receive [b]$50 STEAM CREDIT[/b] to spend on whatever game strikes your fancy :-)

As an added incentive to spread the word, if you have a friend who you know loves retro games, indie games & score-chasing in general, tag them in reply to [url=https://x.com/Biggles/status/1707456439520788786?s=20]this tweet[/url] & you'll [i]also[/i] get $50 steam credit if they go on to win!

Lastly, if you'd like to be notified about future playtest sessions, you can [url=https://biggles.games/playtest/]sign up here[/url] & I'll email you when the next one comes around :-)

Thanks again & looking forward to getting your feedback! It really does make a world of difference & will hopefully result in me making the games [i]you want to play[/i] (rather than just the games [i]I kinda feel like making to scratch an itch[/i] ;-)

- Biggles

notes.title: Let's Play Drift Vector!
notes.notes: Hi! I'm Biggles, the developer of "Drift Vector", a minimalist, glowing neon synthwave-inspired, indie, retro arcade asteroids-like game! It's currently very early in development but Steam have kindly included me in this week's SHMUP-Fest! I've never tried streaming before but thought it might be fun to take the opportunity to do so & maybe talk to players, answer questions & generally see what y'all think!
